definitions.explanation: The day-to-day operation and management of systems, services, or organizations.
The management and investment of financial assets to generate returns.
The practical application or flexible use of rules, knowledge, or resources.

notes:
FORMATION: ⟦{運|うん}→運：02143_un⟧ (carry/convey) + {用|よう} (use).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {運用|うんよう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (operate, manage)
- {運用|うんよう}⟦{費用|ひよう}→費用：03588_hiyou⟧ (operating costs)
- ⟦{資産|しさん}→資産：15655_shisan⟧{運用|うんよう} (asset management)
- {運用|うんよう}⟦{実績|じっせき}→実績：04214_jisseki⟧ (track record)
- {運用|うんよう}⟦ルール→ルール：00354_ruuru⟧ (operational rules)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{運営|うんえい}→運営：05096_unei⟧ (management, running) — emphasizes organizational management
- {運用|うんよう} — emphasizes practical day-to-day operation and application
